rules.name: Repeated Failed SSH Logins (Brute Force)
rules.description: Detects multiple failed authentication attempts from a single source IP within a short window, indicating potential brute force password attacks.

rules.name: Password Spraying Campaign Detected
rules.description: Detects a single source IP attempting failed authentications across multiple distinct usernames, characteristic of horizontal password spraying.

rules.name: Successful Authentication After Multiple Failures
rules.description: Detects a successful login for a user account that immediately followed 3 or more failed login attempts, suggesting a compromised credential or successful brute force.

rules.name: Repeated Authentication Attempts on Privileged Accounts
rules.description: Detects multiple authentication attempts targeting high-value administrative accounts (root, administrator, admin).

rules.name: High-Severity IDS Threat Alert
rules.description: Surfaces critical/high intrusion detection signatures from Suricata EVE logs, such as exploit kits, malware command & control, or reverse shells.

rules.name: Suspicious Process or Command-Line Pattern
rules.description: Detects known offensive tools or reconnaissance command patterns (e.g., encoded powershell, certutil download, mimikatz, whoami recon).

rules.name: Multi-Host Authentication (Potential Lateral Movement)
rules.description: Detects an internal or external source IP connecting to more than 3 distinct target hosts in a short time frame.
